# Preset JSON keys

`N` stands for the index (pads 1-8, faders 1-8, ribbon banks 1-3). Factory defaults shown are those of the first instance; per-index defaults are in spec section 5.2. The *raw byte* column is the byte the value becomes on the wire and in `.vw2` files; see [Numbers and the raw bytes](preset-format.md#numbers-and-the-raw-bytes).

| key | values | factory default | raw byte | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slot` | integer 1..25 |  | wire slot index = value - 1 (0..24) | Target slot. Optional; the command line overrides it. |
| `name` | string, up to 16 printable ASCII characters | (empty) | ASCII, padded with 00 to 16 bytes | Preset name. |
| `program_change.send_on_load` | boolean | true | true = 0 (Yes), false = 1 (No) | Send Program Change and Bank Select when this preset is loaded. |
| `program_change.msb` | integer 0..127 | 0 | same as value | Bank Select MSB. |
| `program_change.lsb` | integer 0..127 | 0 | same as value | Bank Select LSB. |
| `program_change.program` | integer 0..127 | 0 | same as value | Program number. |
| `split.curve` | integer 1..8 | 5 | value - 1 | Velocity curve applied to the keybed. |
| `split.enabled` | boolean | false | true = 0 (Split On), false = 1 (Split Off) | true: keybed is divided at the split key; false: single zone. |
| `split.key` | integer 1..36 | 19 | value - 1 | Number of keys, counting from the lowest, that belong to the lower zone. |
| `upper.transpose` | integer -12..12 | 0 | value + 12 | Semitones; 12 is one octave. |
| `upper.midi_to_din` | boolean | true | true = 0 (On), false = 1 (Off) | true: this zone's messages also go out of the DIN MIDI output; false: USB only. |
| `upper.channel` | integer 1..16 | 2 | value - 1 | MIDI channel. |
| `lower.transpose` | integer -12..12 | 0 | value + 12 | Semitones; 12 is one octave. |
| `lower.midi_to_din` | boolean | true | true = 0 (On), false = 1 (Off) | true: this zone's messages also go out of the DIN MIDI output; false: USB only. |
| `lower.channel` | integer 1..16 | 1 | value - 1 | MIDI channel. |
| `sustain.channel` | integer 1..16 | 1 | value - 1 | MIDI channel. |
| `wheel.channel` | integer 1..16 | 1 | value - 1 | MIDI channel. |
| `wheel.direction` | Normal \| Reverse | Normal | 0 = Normal, 1 = Reverse | Normal: turning right raises pitch; Reverse: it lowers it. |
| `reserved.wheel` | integer 0..127 | 0 | same as value | Bytes the vendor editor never shows. Preserved when reading from the keytar; omit unless you know why. |
| `volume.cc` | integer 0..127 | 7 | same as value | Controller number sent. |
| `volume.min` | integer 0..127 | 0 | same as value | Lowest value sent. |
| `volume.max` | integer 0..127 | 127 | same as value | Highest value sent. |
| `volume.channel` | integer 1..16 | 1 | value - 1 | MIDI channel. |
| `ribbon.default_bank` | integer 1..3 | 1 | value - 1 | Bank active when the preset loads. |
| `ribbon.release_mode` | Return \| Latch | Latch | 0 = Return, 1 = Latch | Latch: nothing is sent when the finger lifts; Return: the controller's default is sent. |
| `ribbon.bankN.type` | CC \| Pitch Bend | CC | 0 = CC, 1 = Pitch Bend | Send a controller (CC) or pitch bend. |
| `ribbon.bankN.cc` | integer 0..127 | 1 | same as value | Controller number (used when type is CC). |
| `ribbon.bankN.min` | integer 0..127 | 0 | same as value | Lowest value sent. |
| `ribbon.bankN.max` | integer 0..127 | 127 | same as value | Highest value sent. |
| `ribbon.bankN.channel` | integer 1..16 | 1 | value - 1 | MIDI channel. |
| `tilt.type` | CC \| Pitch Bend | CC | 0 = CC, 1 = Pitch Bend | Send a controller (CC) or pitch bend. |
| `tilt.cc` | integer 0..127 | 1 | same as value | Controller number (used when type is CC). |
| `tilt.min` | integer 0..127 | 0 | same as value | Lowest value sent. |
| `tilt.max` | integer 0..127 | 127 | same as value | Highest value sent. |
| `tilt.channel` | integer 1..16 | 1 | value - 1 | MIDI channel. |
| `reserved.tilt` | integer 0..127 | 0 | same as value | Bytes the vendor editor never shows. Preserved when reading from the keytar; omit unless you know why. |
| `faderN.cc` | integer 0..127 | 14 | same as value | Controller number sent. |
| `faderN.min` | integer 0..127 | 0 | same as value | Lowest value sent. |
| `faderN.max` | integer 0..127 | 127 | same as value | Highest value sent. |
| `faderN.channel` | integer 1..16 | 1 | value - 1 | MIDI channel. |
| `reserved.fader1` | integer 0..127 | 0 | same as value | Bytes the vendor editor never shows. Preserved when reading from the keytar; omit unless you know why. |
| `padN.type` | Note \| CC Toggle \| CC Momentary \| Program Change \| Panic | Note | 0 = Note, 1 = CC Toggle, 2 = CC Momentary, 3 = Program Change, 4 = Panic | What the pad does. Determines which of the value keys below apply. |
| `padN.note` | integer 0..127 |  | same as value | Note pads: note number. |
| `padN.velocity` | integer 0..127 |  | same as value | Note pads: fixed velocity; 0 means use the velocity curve. |
| `padN.curve` | integer 1..8 |  | value - 1 | Note pads: velocity curve. |
| `padN.cc` | integer 0..127 |  | same as value | CC Toggle / CC Momentary pads: controller number. |
| `padN.on_value` | integer 0..127 |  | same as value | CC Toggle pads: value sent when switched on. |
| `padN.off_value` | integer 0..127 |  | same as value | CC Toggle pads: value sent when switched off. |
| `padN.press_value` | integer 0..127 |  | same as value | CC Momentary pads: value sent on press. |
| `padN.release_value` | integer 0..127 |  | same as value | CC Momentary pads: value sent on release. |
| `padN.program` | integer 0..127 |  | same as value | Program Change pads: program number. |
| `padN.bank_lsb` | integer 0..127 |  | same as value | Program Change pads: bank LSB. |
| `padN.bank_msb` | integer 0..127 |  | same as value | Program Change pads: bank MSB. |
| `padN.channel` | integer 1..16 | 10 | value - 1 | MIDI channel the pad sends on. |
| `padN.color1` | LED Off \| Chartreuse \| Green \| Aquamarine \| Cyan \| Azure \| Blue \| Violet \| Magenta \| Rose \| Red \| Orange \| Yellow \| White | Blue | 0 = LED Off, 1 = Chartreuse, 2 = Green, 3 = Aquamarine, 4 = Cyan, 5 = Azure, 6 = Blue, 7 = Violet, 8 = Magenta, 9 = Rose, 10 = Red, 11 = Orange, 12 = Yellow, 13 = White | LED colour. Note pads: idle. Other types: idle/released. |
| `padN.color2` | LED Off \| Chartreuse \| Green \| Aquamarine \| Cyan \| Azure \| Blue \| Violet \| Magenta \| Rose \| Red \| Orange \| Yellow \| White | Green | 0 = LED Off, 1 = Chartreuse, 2 = Green, 3 = Aquamarine, 4 = Cyan, 5 = Azure, 6 = Blue, 7 = Violet, 8 = Magenta, 9 = Rose, 10 = Red, 11 = Orange, 12 = Yellow, 13 = White | LED colour. Note pads: struck with velocity 1-63. Other types: on/pressed. |
| `padN.color3` | LED Off \| Chartreuse \| Green \| Aquamarine \| Cyan \| Azure \| Blue \| Violet \| Magenta \| Rose \| Red \| Orange \| Yellow \| White | Yellow | 0 = LED Off, 1 = Chartreuse, 2 = Green, 3 = Aquamarine, 4 = Cyan, 5 = Azure, 6 = Blue, 7 = Violet, 8 = Magenta, 9 = Rose, 10 = Red, 11 = Orange, 12 = Yellow, 13 = White | LED colour (Note pads only): struck with velocity 64-95. |
| `padN.color4` | LED Off \| Chartreuse \| Green \| Aquamarine \| Cyan \| Azure \| Blue \| Violet \| Magenta \| Rose \| Red \| Orange \| Yellow \| White | Red | 0 = LED Off, 1 = Chartreuse, 2 = Green, 3 = Aquamarine, 4 = Cyan, 5 = Azure, 6 = Blue, 7 = Violet, 8 = Magenta, 9 = Rose, 10 = Red, 11 = Orange, 12 = Yellow, 13 = White | LED colour (Note pads only): struck with velocity 96-127. |
